Rina (People Ops): FYI we have an offer needing a comp-band exception + relocation package approval. Candidate: Priya Singh, L3 -> L4 comp band question. Hiring mgr wants an early start. Diego, can you drop the quick facts?
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate has external offer at $145k + 15k sign-on + relocation. Our L4 band midpoint is $138k and cap at $150k. Hiring team asks for $153k base + standard relocation. Wants start 2026-05-04.
Lena (Hiring Manager): Team needs candidate in office by first week of May. We're willing to recommend $153k given rarity of skillset. Also prefer lump-sum relocation to simplify onboarding.
Priya (Compensation): +153k exceeds L4 cap by $3k. Policy allows exceptions up to +2% via comp-committee; anything above requires VP sign-off. Also relocation budgets are contextual (remote vs onsite). Need written justification for market pressure.
Noah (Finance): Budget: relocation funds hit Hiring & Onboarding budget; L4 overage will need reallocation from headcount contingency. We can OK one-off if hiring is mission-critical. Need cost center code change.
Elena (Legal): Background in process. Candidate is clear on visa (US citizen). Relocation paperwork: require signed acceptance and relocation T&C. Start date okay from legal side once offer signed.
Rina (People Ops): Routing proposed: 1) Comp-committee async 2) If approve <=+2%, People Ops can sign. 3) If >+2% escalate to Tomas (VP Eng). I'll initiate ticket.
Offerbot: Offer ticket created #O-4992. https://offers.internal/O-4992
Diego (Recruiter): Dropping market notes: three comps in SF similar roles paying $150-160k, relocation typical. Candidate prefers lump sum $8k relocation.
Priya (Compensation): Comp-committee voting now. Recommendation: approve up to +2% (to $141.8k) OR approve $140k + $8k sign-on + $8k relocation to land talent without setting base precedent.
Lena (Hiring Manager): Sign-on + relocation tradeoff okay but manager strongly prefers base at $153k to avoid churn. Team worried sign-on won't retain them long term.
Tomas (VP Eng): If comp-committee can't meet quickly, I'll step in. I'm willing to approve up to $152k but need a retention plan (36-month vesting / performance milestone) or higher RSU. Also want hiring timeline evidence.
Priya (Compensation): Committee timed vote: majority favors structured package (lower base + sign-on + relocation) to avoid stretching band floor. Recording rationale in O-4992.
Rina (People Ops): Noted. Escalating to Tomas for final call since manager requests higher base.
Tomas (VP Eng): Approve $152k base + $8k relocation + $10k sign-on contingent on 18-month retention clause (repay if leave <18 months) and 2-stage RSU grant. Start date approved for 2026-05-04. Documenting as exception limited to this role.
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate verbally accepts the structure. Will send formal offer and relocation T&C.
Offerbot: Offer O-4992 status: APPROVED (base $152,000, sign-on $10,000, relocation $8,000, start 2026-05-04). Offer packet queued.
Noah (Finance): I'll update cost codes and confirm funding. Please route payroll ticket after signed offer.
Elena (Legal): I'll prep relocation agreement and retention repayment clause.
Rina (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll attach exception memo to the HR exceptions log and mark ticket closed once signed.
Lena (Hiring Manager): Huge thanks 91d3fb — relieved to have them join the team.
Diego (Recruiter): Sending the signed offer now. :tada: 
Rina (People Ops): Closing thread. Will include this case in monthly comp exception summary.
